def lines_fill(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    vals=[v for r in g for v in r]; mk=min(set(vals),key=vals.count)
    cells={(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==mk}
    rows=[i for i in range(h) if sum(1 for j in range(w) if (i,j) in cells)>=3]
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if sum(1 for i in range(h) if (i,j) in cells)>=3]
    # minimal cover check: markers not on any line
    uncov=[c for c in cells if c[0] not in rows and c[1] not in cols]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    R=set(rows); C=set(cols)
    for i in rows:
        js=[j for j in range(w) if (i,j) in cells]
        # span between perpendicular lines crossed
        cl=[j for j in cols]
        lo,hi=min(cl),max(cl)
        for j in range(lo,hi+1):
            if g[i][j]!=mk: out[i][j]=2
    for j in cols:
        rl=[i for i in rows]
        lo,hi=min(rl),max(rl)
        for i in range(lo,hi+1):
            if g[i][j]!=mk: out[i][j]=2
    return out,rows,cols,uncov

def mk_cells(g):
    vals=[v for r in g for v in r]; mk=min(set(vals),key=vals.count)
    return mk,{(i,j) for i in range(len(g)) for j in range(len(g[0])) if g[i][j]==mk}

def sandwich(g, need_col_sand=True, min_col_markers=0):
    mk,cells=mk_cells(g)
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for (i,j) in set((i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]!=mk):
        rs=[a for a in range(w) if (i,a) in cells]
        cs=[a for a in range(h) if (a,j) in cells]
        rsand= len(rs)>=2 and min(rs)<j<max(rs)
        csand= len(cs)>=2 and min(cs)<i<max(cs)
        cond=rsand and (csand if need_col_sand else (len(cs)>=min_col_markers if min_col_markers else True))
        if cond: out[i][j]=2
    return out
